svg.title: FirstShift Navigate
svg.desc: FirstShift Navigate: the sails and the name. Two layouts, stack (120 x 100) and row (205 x 60). Colours: --mk-navy, --mk-blue, --mk-ink, --mk-tool (tool colour #0E7C86 light, #3CCFD9 dark); fallbacks are the light theme. Made by tools/make_marks.py from Space Grotesk 700 (SIL Open Font Licence).
